param.name: plugin:notificator:jbSlackNotifier:channel
param.description: User or channel to send notifications to

param.name: plugin:notificator:jbSlackNotifier:addBranch
param.description: Add branch name to notification message

param.name: plugin:notificator:jbSlackNotifier:addChanges
param.description: Add changes, committers and commit date to notifications

param.name: plugin:notificator:jbSlackNotifier:maximumNumberOfChanges
param.description: Maximum number of changes to include in notifications

option.name: customMessageFormat
option.description: Build notifications are rendered from templates. Templates can contain Slack markup, TeamCity parameter references (%build.number%, %env.TARGET%) and placeholders in curly braces: {build.emoji}, {build.event}, {build.link}, {build.url}, {build.number}, {build.name}, {build.branch}, {build.status}, {build.triggeredBy}, {project.name}, {changes}, {changes.count}, {changes.link}, {committers}, {committers.mentions}, {tests.failed}, {tests.failed.count}, {problems}, {problems.count}

param.name: plugin:notificator:jbSlackNotifier:customTemplate
param.description: Template used for all build events unless a more specific template is set

param.name: plugin:notificator:jbSlackNotifier:customTemplateFailure
param.description: Template for failed builds (also used for builds that failed to start or started to fail)

param.name: plugin:notificator:jbSlackNotifier:maximumNumberOfChanges
param.description: Maximum number of changes listed by the {changes} placeholder, 10 by default

example.description: Adds notifications build feature that sends notifications when build has failed to start
Adds notifications build feature that sends verbose notifications. Notifications will contain build branch, build status and list all code changes, up to a specified maximum.
Adds notifications build feature that renders notifications from custom templates: failed builds mention the committers and list the failed tests, other events use the default template.
